select * from (
select '1' paType, pcpf.CDATE as CDATE, pp.PORTFOLIO_ID || '(' || pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME || ')' as portfolioId, sci.ACCT_NAME || '(' || sci.ACCT_NO || ')' as FUNDACCOUNT,
CASE WHEN (NVL(ptpd.PA_BUSS_TYPE, ptfpdt.PA_BUSS_TYPE) = '22' OR NVL(ptpd.PA_BUSS_TYPE, ptfpdt.PA_BUSS_TYPE) = '24') and (nvl(trd.ps, tfpdt.ps) = 'T01' OR nvl(trd.ps, tfpdt.ps) = 'T02') THEN nvl(trd.FINPROD_TYPE2, tfpdt.FINPROD_TYPE2) ELSE nvl(ptpd.PA_BUSS_TYPE, nvl(ptfpdt.PA_BUSS_TYPE, nvl(trd.FINPROD_TYPE2, tfpdt.FINPROD_TYPE2))) END CASHFLOWTYPE, nvl(trd.ps, tfpdt.ps) CASH_TYPE, nvl(nvl(ftp.finprod_id, fp.FINPROD_ABBR),fp.FINPROD_NAME) as ASSETSIGN, ROUND(nvl(pcpf.AMOUNT,0)/#{displayAccuracy},2) as CASHFLOW, pcpf.CCY ccy from PTL_CASH_POSITION_FLOW pcpf left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pcpf.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join STL_PAY_ORDERS spo on pcpf.ORDER_ID = spo.ORDER_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL trd on spo.TRADE_ID = trd.TRADE_ID left join PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ptpd on ptpd.TRADE_ID = trd.TRADE_ID left join TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt on spo.TRADE_ID = tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL ptfpdt on ptfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = nvl(trd.FINPROD_ID,tfpdt.FINPROD_ID) left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FTP on FTP.FINPROD_ID = nvl(trd.FINPROD_ID,tfpdt.FINPROD_ID) left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD on fp.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY pa on pa.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on sci.ACCT_NO = pcpf.acct_id where ( (trd.TRADE_ID is not null and trd.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND trd.IS_CANCEL='N') or (tfpdt.TOTLE_TRADE_ID is not null and tfpdt.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND tfpdt.IS_CANCEL='N') )
and (pcpf.PORTFOLIO_ID in
null) OR pcpf.PORTFOLIO_ID in (
#{item} )
AND (FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PROD_MANAGER IN
null) OR FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PROD_MANAGER IN ( #{item} )
and (pcpf.ACCT_ID in
null) or pcpf.ACCT_ID in (
#{item} )
AND (pcpf.CDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{searchDateEnd},'YYYY-MM-DD'))
and pcpf.HODING_TYPE = '03' and pa.USER_ID = #{userId}
and pcpf.CCY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
union all
select distinct '0' paType, fcp.PAY_DATE as CDATE, pp.PORTFOLIO_ID || '(' || pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME || ')' as portfolioId, sci.ACCT_NAME || '(' || sci.ACCT_NO || ')' as FUNDACCOUNT,
nvl(ftp.FINPROD_TYPE2,fp.FINPROD_TYPE2) CASHFLOWTYPE, fcp.CASH_TYPE, nvl(nvl(ftp.finprod_id, fp.FINPROD_ABBR),fp.finprod_name) as ASSETSIGN, case when fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F02' then -1 * ROUND(psp.AMOUNT*fcp.CASH_AMT/nvl(fcp.CASH_BASEAMT,1)/#{displayAccuracy},2) WHEN FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{F01}/*到期还本*100*/ THEN ROUND(psp.AMOUNT*fcp.CASH_AMT/#{displayAccuracy},2) WHEN FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' and fcp.CASH_TYPE = '05' /*产品费用支付*/ THEN ROUND(BPP.TDY_UNPAID_INTINCEXP,2) WHEN FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' and fcp.CASH_TYPE = '01' /*产品中间收息*/ THEN ROUND(BPP1.TDY_UNPAID_INTINCEXP,2) else ROUND(psp.AMOUNT*fcp.CASH_AMT/nvl(fcp.CASH_BASEAMT,1)/#{displayAccuracy},2) end as CASHFLOW, psp.ccy from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pci on psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pci.PORTFOLIO_ID and pci.ACCT_TYPE = 'A01' and pci.ccy=psp.ccy left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on pci.ACCT_NO = sci.ACCT_NO left join FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp on fcp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FTP on FTP.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD on fp.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY pa on pa.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fcp.FINPROD_ID = fci.FINPROD_ID and fci.cash_id = fcp.cash_id left JOIN BOK_POSITION_PRDFEE BPP ON fcp.FINPROD_ID = BPP.FINPROD_ID AND fcp.BRANCH = BPP.BRANCH AND 1 = fcp.MDATE -BPP.CDATE and fci.CASH_TYPE_2 = BPP.FEE_TYPE left JOIN BOK_POSITION_PRD BPP1 ON fcp.FINPROD_ID = BPP1.FINPROD_ID AND fcp.BRANCH = BPP1.BRANCH AND 1 = fcp.MDATE -BPP1.CDATE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD PRODADD ON (PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = PRODADD.PORTFOLIO_ID or pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID = PRODADD.PORTFOLIO_ID) LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PROD ON PRODADD.FINPROD_ID = PROD.FINPROD_ID where PROD.VDATE <= FCP.VDATE /*过滤掉产品陈立日之前的计划*/
and psp.PORTFOLIO_ID in
#{item}
and pci.ACCT_NO in
#{item}
AND (FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PROD_MANAGER IN

#{item} )
AND (fcp.PAY_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{searchDateEnd},'YYYY-MM-DD'))
and not exists ( select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd where tpd.CASH_ID = fcp.CASH_ID and TPD.MDATE > FCP.VDATE AND FCP.MDATE >= TPD.MDATE and tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TPD.IS_CANCEL='N'
) /*平台日当天是付息截止日，用前一天的持仓来预测，当天增加或减少的持仓不影响利息预测*/ and ((fcp.MDATE = to_date(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND psp.CDATE = to_date(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') - 1) OR (fcp.MDATE != to_date(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND psp.CDATE = to_date(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD'))) and (fp.IS_RIGHT = 'N' or fp.IS_RIGHT is null) and pa.USER_ID = #{userId}
and (fp.CCY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or FTP.CCY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
and psp.AMOUNT > 0 union all
select distinct '0' paType, fcp.PAY_DATE as CDATE, pp.PORTFOLIO_ID || '(' || pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME || ')' as portfolioId, sci.ACCT_NAME || '(' || sci.ACCT_NO || ')' as FUNDACCOUNT,
fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 as CASHFLOWTYPE, fcp.CASH_TYPE, nvl(fp.FINPROD_ABBR,fp.finprod_name) as ASSETSIGN, ROUND(psp.AMOUNT*fcp.CASH_AMT/#{displayAccuracy},2) CASHFLOW, fp.ccy from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pci on psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pci.PORTFOLIO_ID and pci.ACCT_TYPE = 'A01' and pci.ccy=psp.ccy left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on pci.ACCT_NO = sci.ACCT_NO left join FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp on fcp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD on fp.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY pa on pa.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD PRODADD ON (PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = PRODADD.PORTFOLIO_ID or pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID = PRODADD.PORTFOLIO_ID) LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PROD ON PRODADD.FINPROD_ID = PROD.FINPROD_ID where PROD.VDATE <= FCP.VDATE /*过滤掉产品陈立日之前的计划*/
and psp.PORTFOLIO_ID in
#{item}
and pci.ACCT_NO in

null) OR FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PROD_MANAGER IN in (
#{item} )
AND (fcp.PAY_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{searchDateEnd},'YYYY-MM-DD'))
and not exists ( select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd where tpd.CASH_ID = fcp.CASH_ID and tpd.MDATE > fcp.VDATE and fcp.MDATE >= tpd.MDATE and tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TPD.IS_CANCEL='N' ) /*平台日当天是付息截止日，用前一天的持仓来预测，当天增加或减少的持仓不影响利息预测*/ and ((fcp.MDATE = to_date(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND psp.CDATE = to_date(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') - 1) OR (fcp.MDATE != to_date(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND psp.CDATE = to_date(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD'))) and fp.IS_RIGHT = 'Y' and ( NOT EXISTS ( select 1 from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN fep where fep.EXERCISE_DATE >= to_date(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND fep.FINPROD_ID = FCP.FINPROD_ID ) or NOT EXISTS ( select 1 from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN fep where fep.EXERCISE_DATE >= to_date(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND fep.FINPROD_ID = FCP.FINPROD_ID AND fcp.PAY_DATE > fep.EXERCISE_DATE ) )
and fp.CCY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and psp.AMOUNT > 0 and pa.USER_ID = #{userId}
union all
select distinct '0' paType, fep1.EXERCISE_DATE as CDATE, pp.PORTFOLIO_ID || '(' || pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME || ')' as portfolioId, sci.ACCT_NAME || '(' || sci.ACCT_NO || ')' as FUNDACCOUNT,
fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 as CASHFLOWTYPE, '行权' CASH_TYPE, nvl(fp.FINPROD_ABBR,fp.finprod_name) as ASSETSIGN, psp.AMOUNT*fep1.EXERCISE_PRICE CASHFLOW, fp.ccy ccy from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY pa on pa.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id left join PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pci on psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pci.PORTFOLIO_ID and pci.ACCT_TYPE = 'A01' and pci.ccy=psp.ccy left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on pci.ACCT_NO = sci.ACCT_NO left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD on fp.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN fep1 on fep1.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD PRODADD ON (PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = PRODADD.PORTFOLIO_ID or pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID = PRODADD.PORTFOLIO_ID) LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PROD ON PRODADD.FINPROD_ID = PROD.FINPROD_ID
PROD.VDATE <= fep1.VDATE /*过滤掉产品陈立日之前的计划*/ AND psp.AMOUNT > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN FEP WHERE FEP.CASH_ID = FEP1.CASH_ID AND FEP.EXERCISE_DATE < FEP1.EXERCISE_DATE AND FEP.FINPROD_ID = FEP1.FINPROD_ID)
and psp.PORTFOLIO_ID in
#{item}

#{item} )
AND (fep1.EXERCISE_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{searchDateEnd},'YYYY-MM-DD'))
and not exists ( select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd where tpd.PS in(#{T03},#{T39}) and tpd.SETTLE_DATE = fep1.EXERCISE_DATE AND TPD.FINPROD_ID = PSP.FINPROD_ID and tpd.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TPD.IS_CANCEL='N' ) and PSP.CDATE = to_date(#{searchDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') and fp.IS_RIGHT = 'Y' and fep1.EXERCISE_DATE is not null and pa.USER_ID = #{userId}
and fp.CCY = #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
) total ORDER BY CDATE, portfolioId, CASHFLOWTYPE
